Sallow notes the address and says he will send word there when he has an answer; he wishes the party well and signals the ordinary conclusion of the business audience. No actual message dispatch, broker response, Harthvale agreement, meeting time, new attendee or guaranteed reply established yet. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar remain in the business room at the end of audience, free to depart or speak further; no V movement, Watch report or other choice assumed. Existing signed Tavosk referral and handwritten notes remain V-held; no new check, feature use, resource or custody change apart from Sallow learning the reply destination.
